theorems.name: TFPT.SourceReconstruction.compression_star_mul_self
theorems.scope: In any starred ring, for self-adjoint idempotent C and star U * U = 1, the compression S=C*U*C obeys star S*S=C-C*star U*(1-C)*U*C.

theorems.name: TFPT.SourceReconstruction.compression_isometry_iff_leakage_zero
theorems.scope: Under the same algebraic hypotheses, the corner relation star S*S=C is equivalent to vanishing of the displayed leakage element.

theorems.name: TFPT.SourceReconstruction.integer_character_recurrence
theorems.scope: For b:Z->Q, b(n+1)=b(n)+1 and b(0)=alpha imply b(n)=n+alpha for every positive and negative integer n.

theorems.name: TFPT.SourceReconstruction.quarter_one_coset
theorems.scope: The alpha=1/4 recurrence lies exactly in 1/4+Z.

theorems.name: TFPT.SourceReconstruction.quarter_three_coset
theorems.scope: The alpha=3/4 recurrence lies exactly in 3/4+Z.
